constraints.scope: Concept coverage only. Profile/era/unlock gates still apply; no new rules or universal kit availability.

materials.name: Timber
materials.brief: Warm sawn planks with broad end grain, pegs and irregular tool marks; retain straight mating edges.

materials.name: Pine
materials.brief: Pale long straight grain and small dark knots; lighter rough cut edges than ordinary timber.

materials.name: Bog Oak
materials.brief: Dense nearly black brown wood, water-dark pores and burnished worn corners; grain remains visible in shade.

materials.name: Ash Wood
materials.brief: Bone-pale fibrous grain and weathered silver edges; a timber surface, not bone or snow.

materials.name: Stone
materials.brief: Dressed grey courses with restrained chips and visible bedding; regular joints distinguish worked masonry from fieldstone.

materials.name: Iron
materials.brief: Dark hammered iron, broad rivet heads and oxide in protected seams; muted metal, no generic orange glow.

materials.name: Bronze
materials.brief: Warm cast/hammered bronze with dark green patina in recesses; curved arch remains recognisably worked metal.

materials.name: Steel
materials.brief: Cooler tightly finished plates, darker weld/fastener lines and sharper worn edges than iron.

materials.name: Silver
materials.brief: Pale soft metal with dark tarnished recesses; curved and structural forms only where the existing traits permit them.

materials.name: Charcoal
materials.brief: Angular porous black fuel chunks and subtle ash; only the fuel form, never charcoal walls.

materials.name: Fieldstone
materials.brief: Rough varied stones with dry contact joints and lichen remnants; low footing/dry wall only.

materials.name: Slate
materials.brief: Thin dark cleaved layers, offset joints and chipped edge laminations; roofs read in the silhouette at distance.

materials.name: Shellstone
materials.brief: Warm pale cut stone carrying uneven fossil fragments and occasional whole shell impressions; fossils must not tile identically.

materials.name: Rustclay Brick
materials.brief: Warm red-brown fired courses, varied firing marks and restrained pale joints; repeat spacing fits module boundaries.

materials.name: Woven Reed
materials.brief: Over-under reed weave, bundled cut edges and integral lash-bound frame; opaque functional wall coverage despite visible weave.

materials.name: Resinheart
materials.brief: Strong amber-brown grain, dense cut end rings and occasional non-emissive resin pockets; retain the collected tree's identity.

materials.name: Corkbark
materials.brief: Thick porous bark faces, layered cut edge and inset frame; use coarse pores rather than noisy universal bump.

materials.name: Vitrified Basalt
materials.brief: Dark fused rock with broken glossy skin over a matte heavy body; heat-worked material, not an always-burning wall.

materials.name: Cinderglass
materials.brief: Smoky mineral glass with modest distortion and an integral fitted frame; opaque-enough edge/selection readability and existing projectile blocking.

shapes.name: Chamfer Block
shapes.brief: A clipped diagonal block with continuous side grain/courses and a clean diagonal mating face.

shapes.name: Triangular Slab
shapes.brief: Thin triangular slab matching the clipped block; finish the cut edge, preserve exact thickness.

shapes.name: Roof Slope
shapes.brief: One half-height pitched module; layer covering toward the low edge and keep shared roof seams exact.

shapes.name: Roof Hip
shapes.brief: Convex outer roof transition with continuous ridge/corner covering; preserve the same cell envelope.

shapes.name: Roof Valley
shapes.brief: Concave roof transition with a readable drainage valley; no decorative lip blocking the joining module.

shapes.name: Cube Block
shapes.brief: Solid regular module; timber assembly, masonry courses or metal panels express family without changing occupancy.

shapes.name: Wall Panel
shapes.brief: Thin vertical partition with integral believable edges; courses and grain continue at neighbouring faces.

shapes.name: Pillar
shapes.brief: Narrow vertical support with end joints contained in its exact width; optional details must fit real corner geometry.

shapes.name: Beam
shapes.brief: Horizontal support with readable underside and end grain/metal caps; preserve the existing exposed beam section.

shapes.name: Floor Slab
shapes.brief: Flat floor/ceiling module with legible rim; same finish on exposed underside, no floating trim.

shapes.name: Stairs
shapes.brief: Two substantial steps inside one cell; match native stair silhouette, not a new many-tread staircase.

shapes.name: Door
shapes.brief: Single hinged leaf with frame/hinge detail inside the existing wall form; mirrored hinge orientation and actual open/closed state.

shapes.name: Roof Wedge
shapes.brief: Full-height 45-degree cut masonry wedge; distinguish this older stone form from half-height covering roofs.

shapes.name: Girder
shapes.brief: Two-cell metal beam with a visibly reinforced section; no new cable support or structural rule.

shapes.name: Arch
shapes.brief: Worked malleable metal head with half-round underside; clear metal finish prevents confusion with a new masonry arch.

shapes.name: Half Cube
shapes.brief: Half-grid solid for trim or a step; retain material grain scale, avoid an oversized full-block texture squeezed onto it.

shapes.name: Half Wall
shapes.brief: Small face panel for sill/parapet infill; same edge seam contract as its coarse parent.

shapes.name: Half Post
shapes.brief: Slender half-grid post for legs/pickets; no attached decorative finial beyond the body.

shapes.name: Half Beam
shapes.brief: Small rail or sill; matching end grain and joints at the half-cell positions.

shapes.name: Half Slab
shapes.brief: Small shelf/step/roof edge with a finished underside; preserve fine lattice placement.

shapes.name: Chest
shapes.brief: Low jointed storage box; inherited material family, supported hinges and clear lid opening; contents stay in native storage.

shapes.name: Campfire
shapes.brief: Low fuel pile with timber or charcoal-specific shape; burning/ash transition reads native fuel lifetime and heat.

shapes.name: Footing
shapes.brief: Half-height dry-laid rough-stone footing with broad load-bearing base; no full masonry cube implied.

shapes.name: Dry Wall
shapes.brief: Low rough-stone course on a wall face; uneven cap inside dimensions, no new shelter or collision interpretation.

shapes.name: Light Wall Panel
shapes.brief: Framed thin covering wall; family-specific weave/bark/planks/sheets with a complete blocking surface.

shapes.name: Fixed Glazed Window
shapes.brief: Fixed smoky pane and complete integral frame as one piece; no openable window or extra frame recipe.

devices.name: Workbench
devices.brief: Pegged compact timber bench, thick scarred top and contained clamp. Distinct horizontal wood working surface.
devices.method: Direct Blender frame and fitted tools.

devices.name: Basic Forge
devices.brief: Low stone hearth and supported short cowl, iron working face, dark cold basin that lights only with real work feedback.
devices.method: Direct Blender hearth/frame; reusable stone/iron surfaces.

devices.name: Improved Forge
devices.brief: Same forge plinth and footprint with stronger iron collar, better contained hot chamber and visibly refined working plate.
devices.method: Variant of basic forge; no separate kit.

devices.name: Mason's Yard
devices.brief: Squat timber support around a fieldstone dressing bed, attached wedges/chisel rests, cutting dust inside the footprint.
devices.method: Direct Blender support and contained dressed stone.

devices.name: Lanternheart Lamp
devices.brief: Warm Lanternheart core in papery husk within a small timber/reed cage; protect the recognisable recovered heart.
devices.method: Organic core source plus precisely fitted frame.

devices.name: Thrumroot Cargo Winch
devices.brief: Root tension drum on stout timber supports, hand crank, one basket and a distinct cable attachment.
devices.method: Direct mechanism; controlled organic root coil, separate moving drum/basket.

devices.name: Cargo Landing
devices.brief: Plain matching receiving cradle and rope guide; support feet and basket clearance, no second rare core.
devices.method: Direct Blender; share winch timber/iron and attachment grammar.

devices.name: Stormglass Pulse Lever
devices.brief: Ringing lightning-glass tube in clamps, readable tapping hand lever and outgoing request socket.
devices.method: Organic tube plus direct frame/lever with physical pivot.

devices.name: Pullstone Sorting Chute
devices.brief: Inclined hand-fed chute, braced dark Pullstone nodule and two unmistakable receiving trays.
devices.method: Direct Blender chute/trays; organic magnetic nodule.

devices.name: Ventlung Bellows
devices.brief: Folded natural membrane between boards, fibre lashings, priming handle and short directed nozzle.
devices.method: Organic membrane with deformation-friendly topology; direct boards/nozzle.

devices.name: Pressure Feeder
devices.brief: Compact frame with separate clay hopper, fuel cup, root drum, pressure chamber and brick tray; distinct pressure and forge attachments.
devices.method: Direct assembled mechanisms; separate supply meshes driven by native readout.

devices.name: White Connection
devices.brief: Reuse approved White post, fracture material and fitted frame; immediate request path stays visually distinct from receiver winding.
devices.method: Reuse tools/wroughtwild-white and its accepted handoff.

devices.name: Blue Delay
devices.brief: Reuse approved supported flake/delay form; visible held request with a legible local pause/release cue.
devices.method: Reuse tools/wroughtwild-blue and its accepted handoff.

devices.name: Green Junction
devices.brief: Reuse approved resin-root fork with two distinct branch sockets; branch result must not imply free work.
devices.method: Reuse tools/wroughtwild-green and its accepted handoff.

devices.name: Red Heat Buffer
devices.brief: Reuse approved braced heat store, clear charge chamber and existing feeder attachment. Frame material is separate from spent charge.
devices.method: Reuse tools/wroughtwild-workshop and its accepted handoff.

resource_nodes.name: Tree
resource_nodes.brief: Reuse ART-02 broadleaf trunk language; branching silhouette, leaf masses, exposed roots and matching cut stump; ordinary and locally altered finish.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Pine
resource_nodes.brief: Tapered conifer with uneven branch tiers, attached needle clusters and visible trunk gaps; pale cut timber matches the pine building family.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Bog Oak
resource_nodes.brief: Leaning dark oak, flared knuckled waterline roots, sparse lower branches and dense irregular upper crown; dark cut wood.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Ash Snag
resource_nodes.brief: Bleached twisted dead trunk with broken boughs, limited char in splits and readable standing/felled silhouette; not a forest of identical spikes.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Resinheart Tree
resource_nodes.brief: Thick buttressed amber-grain oldgrowth with hanging crown masses and deep structural root channels on altered variant; preserve approved grove ancestry.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Corkbark Deadfall
resource_nodes.brief: Low independent dead trunk with thick porous rolled bark lips; show exposed lighter underlayer as its own finite deposit is worked.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Boulder
resource_nodes.brief: Reuse approved fractured rock as one family; rounded weathering vs hard broken faces, separate removable chunks and final worked remnant.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Stone Seam
resource_nodes.brief: Bedrock face with broad bedding planes and wedge-readable split; integrate visually with surrounding rock while retaining one work target.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Iron Vein
resource_nodes.brief: Ochre iron streaks and dense dull nodules inside broken host rock, not uniform shiny crystal spikes.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Copper Vein
resource_nodes.brief: Weathered green-brown copper-bearing bands in warm host rock; exposed worked interior remains recognisable without blue magic association.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Tin Vein
resource_nodes.brief: Pale granular mineral pockets in dark banded rock; distinct from iron and silver at interaction distance.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Ember-Iron Vein
resource_nodes.brief: Heat-marked dark ore with restrained ember-bearing internal fractures; hot/worked states follow existing rules.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Silver Vein
resource_nodes.brief: Narrow pale metallic seam through dark host rock; broad material contrast survives reduced texture detail.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Layered Slate
resource_nodes.brief: Thin stacked dark sheets with exposed split edge and a readable detachable working face; matching slate roof layers.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Fossil Shellstone
resource_nodes.brief: Pale fossil-bearing bed with scattered shell cross-sections and broad cleaving planes; irregular fossils, not repeated giant medallions.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Rustclay Bank
resource_nodes.brief: Damp rust-coloured earth pocket in a rooted bank with scooped working layers; depleted pocket stays distinct from decorative mud.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Weaving Reeds
resource_nodes.brief: Harvestable mature upright reed bundle with clear cuttable stalk mass; separate low decorative sedge from this work target.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Lanternheart
resource_nodes.brief: Papery lantern husk sheltering a luminous intact heart; harvest reveals/lifts that same core and leaves an empty husk.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Thrumroot
resource_nodes.brief: Bowed deadfall held by taut sinewy roots; exposed reusable coil has the same weave/strain as the winch drum.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Stormglass
resource_nodes.brief: Naturally fused lightning tube partly embedded in scarred ground; ringing hollow form becomes the lever's resonator.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Pullstone
resource_nodes.brief: Dark nodule attracting clinging ferrous grit; working separates one intact visibly dense core from its braced host.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

resource_nodes.name: Ventlung
resource_nodes.brief: Bulged natural membrane in a split host, seam and pressure-release opening visible; lifted membrane becomes the hand bellows.
resource_nodes.method: Reuse approved source where available; organic source/Blender finishing; matched finite work states.

fauna_presentation.brief: Retain approved stag anatomy; White host structure/current variant and existing encounter location.
Retain liked moth and existing Green host influence; wing/thorax glow never replaces actual attack tells.
Retain approved boar with its existing paired influence presentation; no new damage or sustain inference.
Approved boar, Red host variant; structural scar placement remains readable in brush.
Approved boar, Blue host variant; no automatic ice-armour redesign.
Low foraging/rooting art pose in scrub pockets; preserve current combat body and role.
Approved ART-06C face and deep connected quill-root lifelines; keep quill silhouette clear of dense background.
Approved wolf, silhouette visible through trunk gaps; resting/walking art poses, no added pack rules.
Approved uneven horn buttress and lifelines; rocky shelf composition frames broad head shape.
Approved long-leg anatomy and exposed throat resonator; tall silhouette against low vegetation.
Approved displaced plates and deep shell channels; cave/ground detail must not hide its outline.
Approved six-leg nymph and shell lifelines; shallow root-bank composition with clear whole-body read.
Retain liked moth ancestry and current variant; no swarm count increase to fill the fen.
Retain established Ember catalyst moth; warm accent remains below immediate attack-warning salience.
Approved irregular ossified shell and deep channels; side profile reads as an animal, not a boulder.
Approved stag/grazer, browsing/resting art poses with open head/antler background; no new fauna spawns implied.
